PUPIL_MARK_POWER.title: Pupil Mark
PUPIL_MARK_POWER.description: A mark of the Kotodama: Mirror Pupil. Each time you play a card, roll 1d100; on a roll ≤ stacks: the Mirror Image Summons 1, and if the card is an Attack, it is played again with the Mirror Image as the damage source. Then lose stacks.
MIRROR_SHATTER_POWER.title: Shatter for You
MIRROR_SHATTER_POWER.description: The Mirror Image absorbs all unblocked attack damage for you.
